name: Abdelkader Ould Hennia
tagline: engineering, databases, and systems. always building.
about: I am a Backend Engineer who thrives on technical autonomy and performance engineering. Over the past two years, I have focused heavily on the mechanics of backend infrastructure—specifically optimizing relational database queries (PostgreSQL/MySQL), designing asynchronous event-driven architectures (Redis Pub/Sub), and building fault-tolerant APIs.  What sets me apart is my approach to problem-solving: I don't just write functional code; I benchmark it under load, analyze execution plans, and ensure systems remain reliable under high traffic. Whether working with Go, Node.js, or containerized Docker environments, I take full ownership of the lifecycle from architectural design to deployment, I work remotely, take a piece end-to-end, and prefer decisions written down to decisions remembered. Growing toward a Backend Engineer.
